verdict.rationale: Godot is a game engine rather than an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Runtime probes found no official Godot MCP server: a GitHub search of the godotengine org returns 0 results, and an Asset Library search for 'mcp' returns nothing. The MCP servers that do exist are third-party community repos, and the built-in GDScript language server is a different, adjacent feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
